title: Chest radiograph findings: more pneumothorax, effusion, collapse, big heart, mass, nodule and pneumonia
description: Frontal (PA) chest radiographs of adults from NIH ChestX-ray14, one film per patient and none from the first chest-findings pack, each with the bounding box a board-certified radiologist drew around the finding. Candidates were ranked by rule (box label also in the report labels, fewest other labels, a box that is not tiny) and every one was drawn with its box and kept only where the boxed finding is clearly visible. The images are the dataset's 8-bit 1024 px release: no pixel spacing and no orientation tag.
